title: revOS scripts/bin/* Wrapper Output
description: Shape every wrapper under scripts/bin/ must emit when it succeeds (or reports tool-not-installed / tool-failed).

binary.description: The path the wrapper was asked to inspect (or null when no argument was supplied).

observations.description: Tool-specific structured output. See individual wrapper docs for fields.

error.description: When status != ok, a one-line human-readable explanation.
